kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أتأسلم (form IIq)
# أَتَأَسْلَمُ (ʔataʔaslamu) /ʔa.ta.ʔas.la.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَأَسْلَمَ (taʔaslama)
# أَتَأَسْلَمَ (ʔataʔaslama) /ʔa.ta.ʔas.la.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَأَسْلَمَ (taʔaslama)
# أَتَأَسْلَمْ (ʔataʔaslam) /ʔa.ta.ʔas.lam/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَأَسْلَمَ (taʔaslama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
